originalTitle: What's at stake for Trump in the US midterms?
summary: Anthony Zurcher explains how the results of the midterm elections could reshape the rest of Trump's presidency.
content:
Americans go to the polls on 3 November to choose their members of Congress.

BBC's North America correspondent Anthony Zurcher explains how the 2026 midterm elections could reshape the rest of Trump's presidency.

Read more on our simple guide to the US midterms
